steps.label: A. 初始状态（面板应 display:none，设置区应 display:none）
C. 展开后状态（面板应 flex）
D. 几何与命中测试
steps.eval: (()=>{const q=s=>document.querySelector(s);const vh=innerHeight,vw=innerWidth;const hit=sel=>{const n=q(sel);if(!n)return sel+':MISSING';const b=n.getBoundingClientRect();const el=document.elementFromPoint(b.left+b.width/2,b.top+b.height/2);return sel+(el&&el.closest(sel)?':HIT':':MISS')+'@'+Math.round(b.width)+'x'+Math.round(b.height)+(b.top>=-0.5&&b.bottom<=vh+0.5&&b.left>=-0.5&&b.right<=vw+0.5?'':':OFFSCREEN');};const p=q('.ai-panel').getBoundingClientRect();const m=q('.ai-msgs').getBoundingClientRect();return JSON.stringify({viewport:vw+'x'+vh,panelRect:[Math.round(p.top),Math.round(p.bottom)],panelInViewport:p.top>=-0.5&&p.bottom<=vh+0.5,msgsHeight:Math.round(m.height),hits:['.ai-settings-btn','.ai-clear-btn','.ai-close-btn','.ai-send','.ai-input'].map(hit)},null,1)})()
